closed_lanes.lane: Terminal holotape as an MCM replacement
closed_lanes.evidence: Terminal.psc has zero properties; Holotape.psc is one line; 0 of 339 vanilla Base/Fragments/Terminals implement OnMenuItemRun; no AddMenuItem, OpenMenu or CloseMenu anywhere in 7,854 base scripts.
closed_lanes.consequence: menu structure is CK/ESM data, pre-authored and shipped in an .esp. Papyrus cannot create it at runtime.

closed_lanes.evidence: the live Data/MCM/Config/XDI/settings.ini states in its own header that it holds DEFAULTS and that Data/MCM/Settings/XDI.ini is the USER OVERRIDE layer. Page structure is config.json plus lib.swf - one real config ships a 98,909-byte lib.swf.
closed_lanes.consequence: writing only the INI cannot make a page appear. Also docs/POSITIONING.md line 105 already carries a standing policy against reading third-party configs at all.

closed_lanes.lane: one probe serving both Fallout4.exe and CreationKit.exe
closed_lanes.verdict: NOT A DESIGN DIRECTION - an experiment
closed_lanes.evidence: HookManager::install() installs zero hooks; vprobe/src/main.cpp self-start is gated on GetModuleHandleW(L"Fallout4.exe") so it goes inert in the CK with no error; envgate.py states the CK compiles Papyrus but does not run it; zero BSScript symbols in the entire CKPE capture; three specs already rule it out with a stated mechanism.
closed_lanes.still_true: the launcher is already host-agnostic, and read_rtti/measure_vtable both take --exe.
